choose.can-also-drop: (You can also drag and drop the file to here)
choose.select-or-drop: Select or drag and drop files

info.name: Song Title
info.previewStart-tip: Second at which previewing this song starts
info.previewEnd-tip:
Second at which the preview stops
Empty = 15 seconds after the start time
info.force-aspect-ratio-tip:
On: draw exactly at the aspect ratio set above, with black bars on the rest
Off: use the narrower of that setting and the window ratio
info.lineLength-tip:
Total line length = this value x screen width (default 6), half to each side
Anything wider than the screen always spans the whole frame
info.hold-partial-cover-tip: Default at the head, enable to cover at the tail
info.negative-length-hold-tip:
For holds whose length is written as a negative number (head behind the tail), flip the body so it is still drawn
Off: such holds keep the raw height and display wrongly (default off)
info.note-uniform-scale-tip: Default only scales X axis, enable to scale Note uniformly
info.hold-particle-interval-ratio-tip:
Interval multiplier of hit effects while a hold is held (default 1)
Bigger means sparser; the real interval is the base interval x this value / speed
info.fold-animation-tip:
Transition that folds the chart open horizontally before it starts and folds it back after it ends
Off: no such transition and judge lines keep their normal proportions (default on)

error.preview-start-end-15s: Preview time cannot be greater than 15 seconds
